Frontend library provenance

These two libraries are the same public frontend files referenced by the SRM
page at https://applications.srmist.edu.in/btech when this project was built:

https://cdn.npfs.co/uploads/template/171/6209/publish/js/jquery1.12.4.min.js
https://cdn.npfs.co/uploads/template/171/6209/publish/js/slick.min.js

Original copyright/license notices are retained in the library files.
The original application, tracking and account scripts are not executed.
tools/runtime/srm.js reproduces only the relevant UI initialization settings.
